howto.goal: Finish with a higher net worth than the other bidder.
howto.setup: Two bidders, five lots, and a private value for each lot. Talk first, then send one secret set of bids.

sections.title: Talking
sections.text: Use the table chat before bidding. What you say is not binding — but it shapes the other bidder's guess.

sections.title: Sealed bids
sections.text: Send one set of bids for the lots you want. Neither side sees the other's bids until both are in.

sections.title: Winning
sections.text: Won lots are worth their private value to you. The higher net worth — spare coins plus what your lots were worth — wins.

controls: Click an amount button for a lot to add that bid.
Press Send these bids once for the whole auction.
Chat with the other bidder before you commit — it is part of the game.

frames.say: Five lots, each with a value only you can see.
You bid on the lots you want.

demo.intro: An auction played out in five beats.

frames.say: Two bidders sit down. Five lots are on the table.
Each lot has a private value. Yours is hidden from the other bidder.
They talk. One claims to care only about the first lot.
Both send sealed bids. The higher bid on a lot wins it.
Won lots pay their value. The richer wallet wins.

demo.outro: Bid on what is worth most to you, and do not believe everything said in chat.

steps.say: Read the private value of each lot before you bid.
Talk in chat — a small misdirection can lower the other bid.
Bid on the lots worth most to you, not the ones the rival praises.
Press Send these bids once. You cannot change them afterwards.
